summary_1line: As the Khandava forest burns, the bird-mother Jarita laments for her helpless chicks, who urge her to save herself for the sake of their lineage.

image_candidates.scene_text: A mother bird spreads her wings over four featherless chicks in a nest as a wall of blazing forest fire approaches through the trees.
The tiny unfledged chicks look up at their grieving mother while flames and smoke close in around the branches of the Khandava forest.
Jarita points toward a small mouse hole beneath a tree, urging her chicks to hide as the red glow of the approaching fire lights the forest.
